title: 第二十一章 漫步海滩第二十二章 关于紫萱
content_zh:
我朝矮仔成招招手：“家成，你听我说啊！”
他还是留给我一个越来越小的背影。
既然他正在气头上，我也没必要在这个时候去解释。
人总是这样，越是情绪化的时候，越是情绪化。
“难道我说错了什么吗？”
我在自言自语。
“你没说错什么，只是没那么婉转而已。”
一把熟悉的声音出现在我背后。
我转身一看，原来是三斤姐。
我说：“吓死爹了，你什么时候出现的？走路都没声音的。”
三斤姐说：“我的吨位又不重，走在沙滩上没什么声音很正常啊！
你才不正常，我走过来你还不知道。”
我问：“我和矮仔成说的你都听到了？”
三斤姐说：“是啊！
听到，没想到。”
我说：“为什么出现这事，只能说思想上出了问题。”
我说：“是啊！
真的搞不明白。”
三斤姐撇撇嘴：“你不是不抽烟的吗？刚才抽了好几根烟啊！
连小女孩都说你了。”

我故作大惊失色的样子：“不是吧？你这样都看到了？你可够隐形的。”
三斤姐好奇：“你为什么不抽烟？”
我说：“当然有关联了。
我刚出来工作的时候，去了西南边陲工作。
那边的同事说千万不要随便接别人的烟抽。
不过我偶然也抽烟。”
三斤姐插话：“于是你就上瘾了？”
我说：“开玩笑！
我是那种随便抽烟就上瘾的人吗？”
三斤姐追问：“然后呢？”
我摆摆手：“咳，重点来了啊！
那时候我们同事之间经常聚餐，那天我们几个人去另外一个女同事家里聚餐，去了之后我就觉得奇怪了，其中有个房间是虚掩的，没开灯，貌似里面有人…”
三斤姐赶紧制止我：“喂喂喂，这种昏暗的环境下，你不是想讲鬼故事吓我吧？”
我坏笑着说：“嘿嘿。
然后我们吃完饭后，突然间就听见嘶叫声，是那种歇斯底里的嘶叫声。
原来就是从那间虚掩的房间里传出来的。
女同事说那是她姐，癫痫发作了。
然后我们几个大男人赶紧进去帮忙按着女同事的姐姐，避免她用头撞墙自残。
我们几个大男人好不容易才按住一个女的。
你想想癫痫状态发作时候是怎样的状态。”

三斤姐问：“是怎样的状态呢？你知道不知道？”
我说：“当然不知道啦！
可能是一万只蚂蚁同时咬你的感觉咯！”
content_en:
I waved to Chaozi Cheng: "Jia Cheng, listen to me!"
He still left me with a smaller and smaller figure.
Since he is angry, there is no need for me to explain at this time.
People are always like this, the more emotional they are, the more emotional they become.
"Did I say something wrong?"
I'm talking to myself.
"You didn't say anything wrong, you just weren't that tactful."
A familiar voice appeared behind me.
I turned around and saw that it was Sister Sanjin.
I said, "Dad, I'm scared to death. When did you show up? You can't even make a sound when you walk."
Sister Sanjin said: “I’m not heavy, so it’s normal for me to make no sound when walking on the beach!
You are not normal, you don’t know it when I come here. "
I asked, "Did you hear everything I said to Aizicheng?"
Sister Sanjin said: "Yes!
I heard it, but I didn’t expect it. "
I said: "Why did this happen? It can only be said that there is something wrong with my thinking."
I said: "Yes!
I really don't understand. "
Sister Sanjin curled her lips: "You don't smoke, don't you? You just smoked several cigarettes!
Even the little girl talks about you. "
I pretended to be shocked: "Isn't it right? Have you seen this? You are quite invisible."
Sister Sanjin was curious: "Why don't you smoke?"
I said, “Of course there is a connection.
When I first started working, I went to work in the southwest border area.
My colleagues over there said you should never accept other people’s cigarettes casually.
But I smoke occasionally. "
Sister Sanjin interjected: "So you became addicted?"
I said, "You're kidding!
Am I the kind of person who gets addicted to smoking casually? "
Sister Sanjin asked: "What then?"
I waved my hand: "Ahem, here comes the point!
At that time, our colleagues often had dinner together. That day, a few of us went to another female colleague’s house for dinner. After we went there, I felt strange. One of the rooms was ajar with no lights on. It seemed like there was someone inside..."
Sister Sanjin quickly stopped me: "Hey, hey, in this dark environment, don't you want to tell a ghost story to scare me?"
I smiled evilly and said, “Hey.
Then after we finished eating, we suddenly heard a scream, a hysterical scream.
It turned out that it was coming from that hidden room.
The female colleague said it was her sister who was having an epileptic seizure.
Then a few of us grown men rushed in to help hold down the female colleague’s sister to prevent her from banging her head against the wall and injuring herself.
It took a lot of effort for us grown men to hold down a woman.
Think about what it is like during an epileptic state. "
Sister Sanjin asked: "What's the state like? Do you know?"
I said, "Of course I don't know!
It might feel like ten thousand ants biting you at the same time! "
